name: Jam (Raspberry)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in small portions for SIBO patients. The cooking process reduces FODMAP content compared to fresh raspberries.
preparationTips: Stick to 1 tablespoon serving to maintain low FODMAP status
Check labels for added high FODMAP ingredients like honey or high fructose corn syrup
Choose jam with sugar rather than artificial sweeteners like sorbitol
Store opened jam in refrigerator and use clean utensils to prevent contamination
